batch.title: Navigation, accessibility, responsiveness, and reliability
batch.goal: Finish canonical routes, URL state, accessible responsive UI, bounded data access, performance budgets, recovery states, and observability.
exitCriteria: Critical journeys pass at phone, tablet, and desktop sizes using keyboard and screen-reader-oriented checks.
Navigation, query, performance, monitoring, retry, offline, and error-recovery budgets pass.

findings.title: Live-broken nav targets: cmd+N pushes nonexistent /tours/new,/events/new; dead quick-action links

specTasks.title: Time/currency
acceptanceCriteria: Storage in UTC, venue-local display, daylight-saving behavior, base/reporting currency, FX source, and rounding rules

specTasks.title: Create KPI catalog/template
acceptanceCriteria: Product/data owners document definition/source/freshness/access/test for every existing and planned Admin metric; duplicate/conflicting metrics are flagged.

specTasks.title: Inventory reporting consumers
acceptanceCriteria: Every dashboard/card/chart/export/query has source, formula, org filter, failure behavior, owner, canonical replacement and retirement plan.

specTasks.title: Build command-center summary contract
acceptanceCriteria: Identity/version/lifecycle/access, domain counts/risks/freshness/degraded states and direct remediation links are typed and contract-tested.

specTasks.title: Implement event-driven read-model updates
acceptanceCriteria: Domain/outbox events update idempotently; per-source watermarks, replay/rebuild, lag and reconciliation are available.

specTasks.title: Add protected aggregate policy
acceptanceCriteria: Finance/personnel/ticket/customer/incident metrics require capability and suppress unauthorized dimensions/drilldowns without inference leaks.

specTasks.title: Add transaction/outbox fault tests
acceptanceCriteria: Inject failure before/after commit and during retry; no partial false success, lost message, duplicate side effect or inaccessible recovery state.

specTasks.title: Add concurrency/idempotency suite
acceptanceCriteria: Autosave, reorder, publish, bulk assignment, inventory, scan, finance posting and provider webhooks behave deterministically under duplicate/racing requests.

specTasks.title: Route/logistics dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Uses normalized legs/manifests/rooms/equipment/meals; completeness and risks have defined denominators, freshness, owner and drilldown.

specTasks.title: Add time/currency/location test library
acceptanceCriteria: DST, time-zone transitions, local-day boundaries, currencies/exponents/FX/rounding and address/location edge cases are reusable across domains.

specTasks.title: Workforce/advance/live dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage/conflicts/credentials/cost, advance status, publication acknowledgement, timeline variance/tasks/incidents/check-in use governed definitions.

specTasks.title: Add offline/realtime suite
acceptanceCriteria: Worker itinerary/day sheet/map/check-in/scan reconnect, stale/superseded/revoked content, queue ordering and permission revocation are tested.

specTasks.title: Ticketing dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical inventory ledger/provider state feeds event/tour totals; allocations/refunds/comps/attendance and reconciliation variance are explicit.

specTasks.title: Finance/profitability dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Approved budget/forecast/commitment/actual/settlement data displays original/reporting currency, FX freshness, variance and outstanding items.

specTasks.title: Vendor/contract dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Engagement/RFP/quote/compliance/contract/signature/obligation/PO/invoice status and risk are attributable and permissioned.

specTasks.title: Add provider contract sandboxes
acceptanceCriteria: Ticketing/signature/email/SMS/map/accounting adapters verify signatures, replay/order, rate limit, timeout, retry, outage and reconciliation before enablement.

specTasks.title: Add reporting freshness/reconciliation UI
acceptanceCriteria: Users see source completeness/watermark and last reconciliation; stale/partial values are not styled as final.

specTasks.title: Add data-quality monitors
acceptanceCriteria: Orphan/unscoped/duplicate source, negative/impossible quantities, mismatched totals, missing dimensions and stale projection create owned alerts.

specTasks.title: Establish performance budgets
acceptanceCriteria: Representative tour/org queries and exports meet agreed p50/p95/queue/render/file-size targets without loading entire raw graphs into clients.

specTasks.title: Retire duplicated client aggregation
acceptanceCriteria: UI consumes governed read models; old formulas/fanout are removed after comparison reports match approved tolerances.

specTasks.title: Build export job service
acceptanceCriteria: Validates org/capability/filter/version/audience, snapshots inputs, renders asynchronously, retries idempotently, expires files, and writes audit/access logs.

specTasks.title: Version CSV/XLSX schemas
acceptanceCriteria: Columns/types/units/time zone/currency/schema version and backward policy are documented; spreadsheet formula injection is prevented.

specTasks.title: Build web/PDF tour book
acceptanceCriteria: Composable authorized sections, table of contents, page headers/version/local time context, accessible web equivalent, overflow/empty/error handling, checksum and publication link are complete.

specTasks.title: Harden ICS/feed exports
acceptanceCriteria: Uses calendar contract and scoped tokens; stable UIDs, updates/cancellations, projection, access logs and revocation are verified.

specTasks.title: Set performance budgets
acceptanceCriteria: Representative datasets establish API p50/p95, database query count/time, page LCP/INP/CLS, JS/bundle, memory, export and job queue targets; CI/staging detect regression.

specTasks.title: Refactor high-fanout pages
acceptanceCriteria: Tour/event/logistics pages use BFF/read models, smaller bundles and typed degraded states; request count and load metrics meet budgets.

specTasks.title: Complete WCAG 2.2 AA review
acceptanceCriteria: Automated and manual keyboard/screen-reader/focus/contrast/zoom/error/table/dialog/mobile checks pass critical Admin/worker/external flows.

specTasks.title: Create production dashboards/alerts
acceptanceCriteria: Platform and domain SLOs, alerts, owners and links to runbooks are live before pilot writes begin.

workflows.title: Navigation, Search, Accessibility, and Responsive Web

producer.outcome: Navigates, searches, deep-links, and completes Admin work using supported input and viewport modes.

recipients.outcome: Reaches one canonical authorized surface with preserved context.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: UI capability awareness never substitutes for server authorization and never exposes unauthorized search results.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Phone, tablet, desktop, keyboard, and screen-reader users reach the same canonical workflow state.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

references.canonicalSource: Shared Admin page header and explicit loading, empty, error, and permission states
invariants: Live Admin UI contains no mock or synthetic operational data.
Every surface provides accessible loading, empty, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior as applicable.

references.canonicalSource: Validated Admin registry, immutable evidence, and generated presentation views
invariants: No status is promoted by historical narrative claims.
Generated views are reproducible and never hand-edited.

launchGates.title: Navigation, accessibility, and responsive acceptance
launchGates.acceptance: Canonical navigation, keyboard, screen-reader, phone, tablet, and desktop journeys pass.

launchGates.title: Performance and reliability acceptance
launchGates.acceptance: Query budgets, retries, idempotency, observability, and failure recovery meet approved thresholds.
